# Silverdale Mechanical Engineering

Silverdale Mechanical Engineering is a family-owned mechanical workshop at 14 Anvil Road, Silverdale, Auckland, with 45+ years of experience servicing cars, trucks, motorhomes and heavy machinery. We offer workshop and mobile on-site repairs, COF/WOF checks, diesel servicing, engine rebuilds and more, backed by a 4.7-star rating from 100+ Google reviews.
